Marissa / team,

Adding the technical prep items we’ll need published as pre-reads:
- Redwood load test plan (attached stub): target QPS, request shape, duration, KV cache warmup steps, and expected cost envelope.
- Prompt set (sample prompts + expected output characteristics) — we’ll accept either a CSV or JSON; keep it to ~50 prompts for kickoff walkthrough.
- Routing matrix: a short doc describing the routing rules you want to evaluate (priority, fallback, region-based).

Attachments I’m sending with this email: redwood-load-test-plan.xlsx (workbook with steps & scripts), prompt-set-v1.csv (sample prompts). Please confirm the dataset size (avg tokens per prompt) and whether traffic will be synthetic or a replay of logs.

Prep checklist (short):
- Provide sample prompt file (<= 50 items)
- Confirm target QPS and peak concurrency to test
- Grant access to target project/account or provide sanitized logs

If you want, I can run a small dry-run against a sandbox environment the day before.

Thanks,
